verdict.text: Mixed. Against Meta's SAM 3.1 asked "toy", the tune asked "muse" has AP 0.77 against 0.50, ranks muse as the top match in 22 of 30 photos against 20, and fires on 22 of 30 photos with no muse against 29.

caveats: A small test: 30 photos with muse pasted in and 30 photos without it.
The muse cutouts were pasted into the photos, not photographed together.
The look-alikes are made up (Muse Image) or come from COCO.
This never shows that it tells muse apart from all look-alikes.
Scored on the same test photos as the Nov 3 run.
